boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Hayward-campus settings for silent work, computer-based assignments, tutoring, collaborative sessions, and discipline-focused study.

cards.title: Bring the Whole Study Setup
cards.subtitle: A family-friendly individual study option on CORE’s first floor
cards.notes: Try Room 1-1 when caregiving and coursework overlap; it is available for individual study on a space-available basis.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor room explicitly designated for family-friendly study.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay’s current international student handbook identifies Family Friendly Study Room 1-1 on CORE’s first floor as individual study space available on a space-available basis.
cards.access_notes: Located on CORE Floor 1; drop-in individual use is subject to space availability.

cards.title: Settle Into the Silent Room
cards.subtitle: A designated silent workspace on CORE’s third floor
cards.notes: Choose Room 326 for work that benefits from a silent setting, and arrive with a backup because use depends on availability.
cards.short_summary: The library’s specifically designated room for silent individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay’s current international student handbook lists Silent Study Room 326 on CORE’s third floor among the individual study spaces available on a space-available basis.
cards.access_notes: Located on CORE Floor 3; drop-in individual use is subject to space availability.

cards.title: Plug In on the Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet seating with personal outlets and storage in CORE
cards.notes: Head to CORE’s second floor for a quieter work session; look for the individual seats equipped with outlets and storage.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library floor suited to sustained laptop or reading sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: A CSU East Bay article states that CORE’s second floor is a quiet floor and describes individual seats with personal outlets and storage.
cards.source_title: The CORE Building Shows How East Bay LEED’s the Way in Campus Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Use during current CORE Library building hours; this source does not specify reservations for the open seating.

cards.title: Build a Computer-Based Work Session
cards.subtitle: First-floor technology access inside the CORE building
cards.notes: Start at the first-floor Learning Commons when an assignment needs campus technology; bring your Bay Card for laptop checkout.
cards.short_summary: A technology-oriented library base for assignments requiring a computer.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay identifies the Learning Commons on CORE’s first floor as the laptop-checkout location, while its computer-lab inventory lists the Learning Commons with 131 Windows computers.
cards.access_notes: Located on CORE Floor 1; technology checkout requires a Bay Card and equipment is subject to availability.

cards.title: Pair Quiet Work With Coaching
cards.subtitle: SCAA’s quieter tutoring and coaching room
cards.notes: Use Room 341 when a tutoring or coaching appointment calls for a quieter setting; arrange the academic support session first.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated SCAA room used for quieter tutoring and coaching appointments.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s SCAA annual report identifies CORE Room 341 as “Quiet SCAA” and says it serves tutoring and coaching appointments as well as trainings, meetings, and workshops.
cards.access_notes: Use is tied to SCAA tutoring, coaching, training, meeting, or workshop activity; confirm through SCAA before visiting.

cards.title: Work Through a Course in SI
cards.subtitle: A CORE room dedicated primarily to Supplemental Instruction
cards.notes: Check your course’s SI schedule before heading to Room 342, then bring the specific notes and problems you want to review.
cards.short_summary: A structured group-learning room centered on Supplemental Instruction sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s SCAA annual report says CORE Room 342 is used primarily for Supplemental Instruction sessions.
cards.access_notes: Access is associated with scheduled Supplemental Instruction sessions; consult SCAA’s current session schedule.

cards.entity_name: MESA U Peer Lounge, North Science 337
cards.title: Study Alongside MESA Peers
cards.subtitle: Independent and peer study space for MESA U students
cards.notes: MESA U students can bring solo work or meet peers in North Science 337; confirm program access before planning a session.
cards.short_summary: A program-specific peer lounge supporting both solo and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: The official MESA University page identifies its Peer Lounge in North Science 337 as a study space for MESA U students working independently or with peers.
cards.access_notes: Available to MESA U students; contact the MESA University Program for current access details.

cards.title: Use MESA’s Second Study Base
cards.subtitle: An additional independent-or-peer workspace for MESA U students
cards.notes: If the Peer Lounge does not fit the task, MESA U students can ask about studying in the adjacent program office, Room 335.
cards.short_summary: A second MESA-designated study setting beside the program’s peer lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: The official MESA University page states that the MESA office in North Science 335 is available for MESA U students to study independently or with peers.
cards.access_notes: Available to MESA U students; coordinate with program staff because this is also the MESA office.

cards.title: Study With Scores and Recordings
cards.subtitle: A soundproofed Music Building room for solo or collaborative work
cards.notes: Bring a music-focused project to MB 1560; use the long table for group work or a quieter area for individual study.
cards.short_summary: A soundproofed resource room combining study space, scores, recordings, and listening stations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay’s Spring 2026 Music newsletter places the Music Resource Center in MB 1560 and says its soundproofed room supports quiet individual study and collaborative work at a long table.
cards.access_notes: Located in Music Building Room 1560; the source does not state public hours or eligibility, so confirm with the Music Department.

cards.title: Set Up in a CBE Computer Commons
cards.subtitle: A six-computer discipline-specific study commons in Valley Business and Technology
cards.notes: Choose VBT 127 when CBE coursework benefits from a desktop station; verify department access and room availability first.
cards.short_summary: A compact, discipline-specific computer commons for CBE study.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay’s discipline-specific computer-lab inventory lists VBT 127 on the Hayward campus as a CBE Study Commons with six Windows computers.
cards.access_notes: Discipline-specific labs are primarily for field-specific study and reservations are handled through the associated department.
